messages:
Eli: thanks for the great turnout today — leaving an open thread for any follow-ups on strategy/positioning.
Maya: short framing: our north star = predictable inference (latency, cost, rollout repeatability).
Jordan: quick FYI: same API surface for hosted/dedicated/private — customers shouldn't rewire.
Liz: roadmap note: next 6mo focus = Dedicated SLA work, Private onboarding flow, and Optimize diagnostics.
Marco: question: how do we say "we're not a model shop" without sounding like we don't care about quality?
Maya: phrase it as "we maximize the value of your model choice" — we make quality repeatable in production.
Hana: sales ask: can we get a one-pager mapping customer problem -> feature to use in demos?
Sam: engineering ask: public benchmark artifact to cite externally?
Liz: yes, marketing + eng will produce a reproducible benchmark repo and short summary PDF.
AllHandsBot: poll: "What should go on the external lead slide?" 1) Predictability 2) Unit economics 3) Private + compliance 4) Observability. react 1/2/3/4.
Eli: we'll synthesize answers + publish a short FAQ and deck by EOW — keep threads coming.
